description: Sales per staff member for a date range — Reports → Employee Sales. Answers 'who is my best seller', 'how much did Maria sell', 'who took the most refunds', 'average ticket per employee'. One row per employee with orders, gross sales, refunds, tips and average transaction. Staff lists are short, so ranking is safe: pull the rows and sort them yourself rather than asking the merchant to narrow down. Pass employeeId to get a single person. For the actual orders one person rang up, use get_employee_orders.

employeeId.description: Restrict to one employee, by id from a previous call

endDate.description: End of the window, ISO 8601. Inclusive of the day when a bare date is given

outlets.description: Outlet ids to restrict to. Omit for all outlets

stations.description: Station ids to restrict to. Omit for all stations
